title.en: Switch between list and grid view

summary.zh-TW: 按右上角的按鈕在清單和格狀之間切換。預設是產品裡最常見的做法：項目先淡出、版面切換、再在新的位置依序浮出，不會有縮放變形。把 MODE 改成 morph，就是用 Flip 讓每個項目從舊位置移動、縮放到新位置。
summary.en: Toggle between list and grid with the buttons at the top right. By default it uses the most common product pattern — items fade out, the layout switches, and they rise in at their new spots without any scaling. Set MODE to morph to have Flip move and scale every item from old to new position.

text.zh-TW: 產品介面最常見的切換方式：舊版面很快淡出（0.18 秒）、瞬間換版面、新版面依序浮出。不會有縮放變形，文字一直清楚可讀。
text.en: The most common product pattern: the old layout fades out fast (0.18s), the layout switches instantly, and the new one rises in item by item. No scaling, so text stays crisp.

text.zh-TW: Flip 讓每個項目從舊位置移動、縮放到新位置，看得出「誰去了哪裡」。適合相簿、檔案、商品這種要追蹤同一個項目的情境；一般清單用 fade 就夠了。
text.en: Flip moves and scales each item from old to new position so you can see what went where. Good for photos, files and products where tracking an item matters; for ordinary lists, fade is enough.

text.zh-TW: 兩種模式都一樣：版面完全寫在 CSS，JS 只切換 class。設計師改清單或格狀的樣子，不用動程式。
text.en: Both modes share this: the layouts live entirely in CSS and JS only toggles a class, so designers can restyle either view without touching code.

text.zh-TW: morph 模式用到：裡面的方塊和文字會跟著外層一起移動，nested 讓 Flip 扣掉外層的移動；scale 讓方塊用縮放過去，比改寬高順。
text.en: Used in morph mode: nested accounts for the parent’s movement so children don’t drift; scale animates the thumbnail by scaling, smoother than resizing.
